study: M8 retrospective squad-value proxy vs Crown T12 AH; historical source data has no publication/receipt evidence

method.squad_proxy: players with an appearance for a team during prior 365 days whose latest pre-cutoff appearance across mapped clubs remains at that team; use each player latest dated market value before target date minus 30 days
method.value_model: fixed expanding-year Ridge alpha 100 predicts difference between Crown home and away one-unit net AH payout
method.test_years: 2024, 2025, 2026; train only on earlier calendar years
method.frozen_eight: post-prediction FID attribution only; not a feature

limits: The valuation gzip is truncated; only complete newline-terminated records are retained, and its final partial CSV record is excluded.
Market-value record date is not proof of source publication or receipt time; valuation cutoff is a fixed conservative 30-day lag.
Appearance history is bulk retrospective data without observed receipt timestamps.
Active squad is an appearance-based proxy, not a verified roster or target lineup.
The valuation archive ends in 2024, so value ages in 2025-2026 grow stale; age is retained and reported.
Historical Crown event-time quotes are not live HTTP execution evidence.
2024-2026 are previously inspected M8 periods and not an untouched holdout.
